name: EBL Bf Neustadt and terminal (example)
description: A bigger part of the lab table, surveyed on 9 October 2026: the station Bf Neustadt with its two platforms and, along the same tracks, a container terminal with a gantry crane over the three loading tracks, a truck lane and a yard block. A town module in front of the table carries the station building, Bahnhofstraße and the bus station. Two tram lines run from Lindenstraße along Ringstraße and Bahnhofstraße, line 1 to Neustadt Bf and the Busbahnhof and line 2 into the Markt, in curves of 25 m, and turn in loops at both ends; where people cross the street to a tram, traffic lights hold the cars; Brückenstraße crosses the main line behind them at a level crossing with half barriers, which trams never cross; bikes, e-scooters and cars with parking share the streets. The marker map comes from arail-survey (three photos and a video); it is locked.

scenarios.name: After the football match
scenarios.description: A crowd surge on platform 2; extra trains are sent.

steps.message: The match is over: fans are heading to platform 2.

layers.name: Infrastructure
layers.description: The station's infrastructure: the exit signals N1–N3 of the electronic interlocking, the displays on the platforms, the interlocking building and a maintenance base on a table module at the end of Bahnhofstraße. Infrastructure → Disruption tells a maintenance story to click through: signal N2 fails, is repaired and exchanged; track G3 is renewed.

scenarios.name: Track G2 closed
scenarios.description: Track G2 at platform 2 is closed for half an hour, as for a repair: no train stops there, track G3 runs as usual.

layers.name: Operations
layers.description: Normal operations at Bf Neustadt on a weekday morning: the trains of the railway undertaking on S 1, RB 71 and RE 2. Railway undertaking → Operations puts a unit and a driver on each train, Infrastructure → Operations puts each train on a track; Run plays the plan. The plan runs the trains of the platforms while it plays: the module is shown alone.

layers.name: Breakdown
layers.description: A railway undertaking at Bf Neustadt: its depot (Betriebswerk) with the workshop and a spare unit, on a table module behind the table. Railway undertaking → Disruption tells a story to click through: RB 31 to Talsee breaks down at track G3, the spare unit comes in at track G2, the passengers change trains, and the broken unit goes to the workshop. Its story takes over platform 2: the module is shown alone.

layers.name: Journeys
layers.description: A traveller's view of the station. Railway undertaking → Journeys tells Ada's journey to click through: she walks from her flat on Bahnhofstraße to platform 1, her RB 31 to Talsee is late and her connection to Altstadt lost, her app finds a bus from the bus station; her journey in numbers and her rights as a passenger.

layers.name: Terminal
layers.description: The container terminal at the loading tracks G14–G16: container trains, trucks, the gantry crane and the yard. Railway undertaking → Terminal moves the containers.

scenarios.name: Morning shift at the terminal
scenarios.description: KT 52 arrives on loading track 3; trucks collect and deliver; the crane works the trains and the yard.

steps.message: Morning shift: KT 52 is due on loading track 3.
